name: selects-editor
description: Connect to the Selects production browser editor and edit through the Selects SDK.

defaultPrompt: Connect to Selects and open its editor
interface.longDescription: Edit videos in the Selects browser editor through your connected account. Open projects, edit drafts, and preview your changes. STT, media analysis, and other AI features may require a Selects subscription or credits purchased from the Selects dashboard.
